tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Find notes. With query: returns ranked block-level hits (note_id, block_id, heading_path, snippet, type). Without query: lists notes newest-first. fuzzy (default true) tolerates typos; match_all requires every keyword (AND). Filter by folder (id or name) and favorite.

folder.description: Folder id or name to restrict to.

tools.name: outline_note
tools.description: Compact map of a note: each block as { n, id, type, depth, len, preview }. Use it to locate the blocks you want before reading or editing — keeps context small. Returns a version token to pass to edit_note. Set headings_only for a table of contents.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read specific parts of a note losslessly. Provide block_ids (ids or short-id prefixes), OR section (a heading id — returns that heading and its content), OR from/to (1-based block window). With none, returns the whole note (capped). Each block includes markdown plus typed payload (latex, code, image, page, checked).

tools.name: edit_note
tools.description: Apply a batch of block operations atomically (all-or-nothing). Each op has an 'op' field: set_text {id, markdown} edits a block's inline text; replace {id, type?, markdown?} swaps a block; insert {blocks|markdown, anchor?, position: before|after|start|end} adds blocks; delete {ids|id}; move {id, anchor, position: before|after}; convert {id, type}; set_checked {id, checked}. Address blocks by id or short-id prefix from outline/read. Pass expected_version (from outline/read) so you never overwrite a note that changed.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a note. Provide body as markdown OR structured blocks. Optional folder (id or name) and favorite. Returns note_id and a version token.

tools.name: manage_note
tools.description: Organize a note: rename, move_to_folder (id or name), clear_folder, favorite (true/false), or delete (true).

tools.name: open_note
tools.description: Open a note in the Notes editor UI.
